entities.name: The Ur-Dragon
entities.description: Enormous Dragon Avatar, primordial essence of all dragonkind and progenitor of the Elder Dragons.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: Elder Dragon, twin of Nicol Bolas, a child of the Ur-Dragon.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Elder Dragon, twin of Ugin, a child of the Ur-Dragon.

entities.name: Birth of the Elder Dragons
entities.description: Event in which the Ur-Dragon created the Elder Dragons.

entities.name: Primeval Dragons
entities.description: Dragons of Dominaria each bearing one trait of the Ur-Dragon.

entities.name: Scion of the Ur-Dragon
entities.description: Dragon that feels a visceral bond with the Ur-Dragon.

entities.name: Ur-Sphinx
entities.description: Echoverse alternate version of the Ur-Dragon.

events.summary: The Ur-Dragon's travels create storms that give birth to other dragons, including Ugin and Nicol Bolas.
events.quote: it creates storms with the beating of its wings: from such storms, other dragons are born
